summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Telegram Bot Integration feature. All 16 backend API tests passed and all frontend UI tests passed. The feature allows admins to connect a Telegram bot, configure listen modes (all/mention_or_command/dm_only), and receive messages via webhook.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - tests use existing instance and clean up after themselves
context_for_next_testing_agent: Telegram Bot Integration feature fully tested. Backend endpoints at /api/admin/telegram-config (GET/PUT/DELETE) and /api/admin/telegram-config/test (POST) all working. Webhook endpoint at /api/telegram/webhook/{instance_id}/{secret} validates secret correctly. Frontend page at /admin/telegram shows Bot Connection card with token input, show/hide toggle, and Connect button that enables/disables based on input. Listen mode selector (all/mention_or_command/dm_only) works correctly.
